texts.text: मुझे थोड़ा rest चाहिए, doctor को बाद में call करो।
I'm a bit tired. Can we talk after lunch?

meta.concurrency: Two other agents may have been calling the Sarvam API (same account) at the same time as this run; this bench's own calls were strictly sequential.
meta.method: TTFA = wall time from just before the library call to the first non-empty PCM chunk at the sink. rest/http-stream: synthRest/synthHttpStream from server/bulbul.ts (Node fetch, keep-alive pool). ws-warm: one TtsEngine (server/bulbul.ts) warmed with engine.warm() plus 2 unrecorded utterances per model. ws-cold: a new TtsEngine per run (socket opened inside the call); connectMs = wall total - library total. clone/http-stream: synthClone (server/clone.ts). clone/rest: POST /voices/clone, same multipart fields, ttfa = full response. v4 Flash speakers pinned per language (vijay_ta_narration, shubh_hi_customer, shubh_en_narration); v3 uses vijay/shubh/shubh. Prosody = Warm preset for every call (v3 receives pace only, as in server/bulbul.ts). Trials shuffled with a fixed seed and run strictly sequentially, at least 1 s start-to-start; 429/5xx/network errors retried up to 4 attempts with 1/2/4 s backoff; failures kept as rows with ok=false.
